source_summary_en: Languages divide meaning differently. Ideas like purpose, reason, destination, recipient, exchange, and deadlines may use one form in one language and several in another. This lesson shows how the language you are learning handles them.
source_tooltip_en: Learn how the language you are learning expresses these relationships.
